highlights.title: Authentic Global Quality & Direct Factory QC
highlights.body: Every unit of Bite undergoes multi-stage inspection for structural durability, surface finish, and material biocompatibility before international dispatch.

highlights.title: Body-Safe Certified Materials
highlights.body: Crafted with medical-grade silicone, CyberSkin TPE, tempered borosilicate glass, or skin-friendly couture fabrics—free from phthalates, latex allergens, and heavy metals.

highlights.title: 100% Discreet Unmarked Fulfillment
highlights.body: Packaged in plain protective boxes with confidential shipping labels. Available for immediate North America & global express delivery.

highlights.title: Wholesale & Private-Label OEM Ready
highlights.body: Supported by our 35,000 m² ISO-certified manufacturing base with custom laser logo engraving, Pantone color matching, and multilingual retail box customization.
